content: Jackson serialization in viaductschema uses jacksonObjectMapper() with ORDER_MAP_ENTRIES_BY_KEYS enabled and KotlinModule registered. Jackson 2.17.3 declared in libs.versions.toml as libs.jackson.databind/module/annotations/core.
JVM bytecode target is 17 (major 61), NOT 11. java-without-tests.gradle.kts sets javaToolchain 17. Bytecode version tests must assertEquals(61, major), not 55.

Scopes package viaduct.graphql.schema.scopes: ScopeIdSyntax validates ^[a-z]+$ IDs, ScopeMode sealed interface, ResourceFileSchema Jackson-serializable with FULL injection. Added jackson.databind/module/annotations/core to viaductschema build.

ValidateScopesVisitor A.8 rule: directive-retained types must use the literal ["*"] wildcard in @scope(to: [...]); explicit full-universe enumeration is rejected. hasLiteralWildcardScope() checks the raw AST directive argument. ScopeDirectiveParser always expands ["*"] to validScopeNames so metadata comparison is insufficient for this check.

ViaductApplicationExtension scope DSL: declaredSchemaScopes(Set<String>) and declaredScopedSchema(id, Set<String>) validate at configuration time (fail-fast). Backed by Gradle SetProperty<String> @Input properties (scopeUniverse, scopedSchemaEntries). getSchemaScopeInfo() returns NoScopesMode when empty, ScopedMode otherwise. common/build.gradle.kts needs implementation(libs.viaduct.shared.viaductschema).

AssembleCentralSchemaTask scope pipeline: 4-phase ordering — (1) declarations validated at config-time by ViaductApplicationExtension, (2) buildUnexecutableSchema via SchemaParser+UnExecutableSchemaGenerator on all .graphqls files including BUILTIN_SCHEMA.graphqls, (3) ScopeMaterializationPipeline materializes each unique scope set with memoization (aliases sharing scope set pay introspection cost once — R-22-002), (4) writeScopeResourceFile emits META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json. NoScopesMode short-circuits before any phase 2-4 code.

Application Gradle plugin jackson dependency: jackson-module-kotlin must be an explicit implementation() dep in gradle-plugins/application/build.gradle.kts because ResourceFileSchema.objectMapper() returns ObjectMapper but jackson is only implementation (not api) in viaductschema — transitive deps are not on compile classpath for consumers. Without explicit dep, 'Cannot access class ObjectMapper' compile error occurs.

ScopeMaterializationPipeline wiring: ViaductApplicationPlugin.setupAssembleCentralSchemaTask() now takes ViaductApplicationExtension parameter and wires scopeUniverse + scopedSchemaEntries SetProperty<String> @Input fields to the task. These are the serialized forms of ScopeMode for Gradle UP-TO-DATE and config-cache compatibility.

description: BatchResolverIntegrationTest in demoapps/starwars fails with ReadTimeoutException on first full test suite run under load.
resolution: Re-run test in isolation; it consistently passes. Confirmed timing flake unrelated to schema/plugin changes. No code fix needed.
